STORY-1843 PR3: F3/F5, FIFO repair and exact-head CI pass; F4/private identity isolation is PARTIAL. I independently read the complete diff and agy1's comment, and disagree with its approval on this remaining gap.

P1 F1 (incomplete-fix), mailbox_root.rs:297: current_user_id(None) unconditionally adds inherited AIDA_USER to inbox identities even after resolving the child's own handle. Launchers export AIDA_USER=plan.name. The new HANDLE/NAME filter does not cover it, so a raw Agy child inheriting the parent handle through AIDA_USER sees and reads/acknowledges parent-private mail. The fixture resets AIDA_USER='fixture-agy' before injecting stale parent variables and misses this. Requested rework: remove parent-agent private identity from the read union while preserving intentional shared audiences; regress inherited parent AIDA_USER, no child notice/body/ack of parent mail, parent can still read, normal child delivery/ack and resume preserved.

Exact-head run 40142509139 is green; downloaded JUnit independently confirms all ten PR3 unit cases, black-box delivery, three scaffold tests and resolver ratchet pass. Supplementary temporary fixture mutation reproduces the privacy leak with the existing author-built CLI; the unchanged fixture passes on that same binary. Its dirty precommit build label is disclosed in the worksheet/comment; source dataflow at the reviewed head is the finding's basis.
